content: AUTOSAR IO Hardware Abstraction shall provide mapping of I/O signals between domain specific and hardware specific units Type: Valid Description: AUTOSAR IO Hardware Abstraction shall provide mapping of I/ O signal s between domain specific units and hardware specific representation.
